Eco Van Overturns in Dholpur, Four Fatalities Reported

On Saturday, an Eco Van carrying passengers overturned into a water‑filled pond near the village of Phoolpur in the Maniya police‑station area of Dholpur district, Rajasthan. The accident occurred amid continuous heavy rain that had been affecting the region. Local residents entered the water and rescued eight occupants from the vehicle. Three children and a woman died in the crash, bringing the death toll to four. Authorities have not yet released an official investigation report.
